help.title: How to use the BOM Editor
help.intro: This screen lets you review and edit a BOM structure before it is created in PLM.
help.tree: Lines are shown as an indented tree. Use the arrows to expand or collapse a branch.
help.edit: Double-click a cell to edit it. Changes are saved automatically and recorded in the change history.
help.actionField: The Action column stages what should happen in PLM: Keep leaves the line, Add creates it, Delete removes it.
help.deleted: Deleting a line keeps it in the list shown struck through, and leaves it out of the export. Use Restore to bring it back.
help.export: Use Export CSV to download the current structure in the original column layout.
help.readOnly: Your role has read-only access. You can view and export, but not edit.
